Case :- Writ - C No. - 2844 of 2023
Petitioner :- Ramakant Srivastava
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Revenue Secrt. Lko. And Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Arvind Kumar Jauhari

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ajay Singh,Shubham Tripathi Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.
Petitioner claims compensation in respect of Gata No.225/13, of which he says that he is the owner having purchased it vide sale deed dated 26.06.1975 from its original owner Nanak Saran.

He says that the said land is in possession of Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Medical Institute & Science,
Lucknow consequent to an acquisition proceedings initiated in 1983.

entities.text:
Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Medical Institute & Science,
Lucknow
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He also says that the land in fact was never acquired, based on some information provided to him under Right to Information Act.
We asked learned counsel for the petitioner to show from any revenue record that he was recorded in respect of said land but he could not show the same and he says that the sale deed is on record.
Now sale deed is of the year 1975.
Admittedly, the petitioner has not been in possession of the land in question at least since 1983 if not prior to it.
We do not know as to whether consequent to the sale deed he was ever put in possession of the land in question.
Almost 47 years have passed since execution of the sale deed.

sentences.text: We, therefore, cannot do anything under Article 226 of the Constitution of India in such a matter.
If the petitioner has other remedies in law, he may avail the same for seeking compensation or possession as the case may be.
Subject to above, writ petition is dismissed.
